verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter publishes a few timing commitments: it opens the case file within 24–48 hours of signing and replies within one business day. It also has an article on what NIW premium processing speeds up, which suggests some government-timeline guidance, but the pack shows no actual figures. The core of the story is not evidenced: there is no published estimate of how long petition and letter preparation takes, and no stated USCIS processing times for I-140, adjustment of status, or other filings. Missing for 10: a published provider preparation timeline (drafting to filing), published government processing time estimates per filing type, and independent corroboration that these timelines are met.
